subject: MAP Kickoff: Draft Mutual Action Plan and Timeline Options - ClearPoint Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@clearpointhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Draft Mutual Action Plan and Timeline Options - ClearPoint Health

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today — I appreciated the context on your integrations roadmap and the latency/cost targets you shared. As promised, attached is an initial draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to help align milestones, owners, and dependencies toward a target production launch.

High-level options for target close / pilot start:
- Aggressive: Pilot start 6/15/2026 — target GA 9/1/2026 (requires procurement + security review complete by 6/1)
- Balanced: Pilot start 7/15/2026 — target GA 10/15/2026 (preferred by most customers)
- Conservative: Pilot start 9/1/2026 — target GA 12/1/2026 (allows extended security/interop testing)

Draft milestone table (see attached spreadsheet and Google Doc):
1) Discovery complete & MAP sign-off — Owner: ClearPoint (Sam) / Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 5/20/2026 — Dependency: internal stakeholders confirmed
2) Security questionnaire & SSO scoping — Owner: ClearPoint (Anika) / Redwood (Laura) — Target: 6/01/2026 — Dependency: security contact assigned
3) Technical deep-dive & test dataset delivery — Owner: ClearPoint (Eng) / Redwood (Aditya) — Target: 6/15/2026
4) Pilot (integration + live traffic test) — Owner: ClearPoint / Redwood — Target: 7/15/2026
5) Contract & procurement complete — Owner: ClearPoint (Procurement) / Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 7/01/2026

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholders for each area (security, procurement, engineering) and which timeline option you prefer? If Balanced looks right, we’ll lock the milestones to that cadence and schedule the technical deep-dive for the week of 6/8.

Attachments: ClearPoint_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestone dates) — also editable Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cClearPoint-MAP-v1

Next steps I’ll take once you confirm stakeholders and timeline:
- Update MAP and share final draft
- Create shared project folder & calendar invites for milestone checkpoints
- Schedule technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer (Aditya) and your eng/security leads

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0183

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turn. The draft looks solid. A few notes from my side after syncing with Jesse (procurement) and Anika (security):

- Stakeholders:
  - Security: Anika Rao (I copied her) — she’ll lead the questionnaire + SSO scoping
  - Procurement: Jesse Morgan — he handles contracts and procurement cadence
  - Engineering: Myself + Rahul Verma (engineer) — Rahul will be the day-to-day

- Timeline: we prefer the Balanced option (Pilot start 7/15, GA 10/15). That gives us time for internal review.

- Dependencies: Anika asked if you can provide a sample SOC 2 report and an outline of the data retention/audit logging capabilities. Also please confirm whether you support client-managed KMS (we may need that for PHI scope).

Can we tentatively schedule the technical deep-dive the week of 6/8 (Tue/Wed morning PST)? I’ll confirm with Rahul and Anika next day.

Sam
